entries.zh: 宇宙诞生于火焰，却冷却为黑暗险恶之地。要繁荣昌盛，我们必须提高温度，即便这会导致其他生命消亡。
entries.en: The universe began in fire, but has cooled down into a dark and hostile place. To thrive, we need to turn up the heat, even if others must perish.
$TRIGGER_FAIL$Requires our population to consist of Thermophiles.

entries.zh: 这片参差闪烁的能量矩阵竟能保持稳定，刚好能够作为燃料运输或嵌入设备。
entries.en: This jagged, shimmering matrix of raw energy is somehow stable, just enough to be transported as fuel or embedded into equipment.

entries.zh: 我们从此危机目标中获得了£entropy_crystals£$AMOUNT$。
entries.en: We have gained £entropy_crystals£ $AMOUNT$ from this Crisis Objective.

entries.zh: 要提升危机等级，需要累积$entropy_crystals$并建造§Y$galactic_crucible_4$§!。
entries.en: To advance through the Crisis levels, accumulate $entropy_crystals$ and construct the §Y$galactic_crucible_4$§!.

entries.zh: $menace_crisis_description_intro$\n\n操控能量的新方法，将大幅增强我们的实力。需利用群星之火点燃新时代。
entries.en: $menace_crisis_description_intro$\n\nA new way to manipulate energy will allow us to vastly increase our power. We will need to harness the fire of the stars themselves to ignite this era.

entries.zh: 完成§H危机目标§!产生£entropy_crystals£§H$entropy_crystals$§!，用于升级$galactic_crucible_4$并解锁下一危机等级。
entries.en: Pursuing §HCrisis Objectives§! generates £entropy_crystals£ §H$entropy_crystals$§!, which can be used to upgrade the $galactic_crucible_4$ and unlock the next Crisis Level.

entries.zh: 另一个帝国已开始控制银河系核心。
entries.en: Another empire is already taking control over the galactic core.

entries.zh: 另一个帝国已控制银河系核心并重塑了星系。
entries.en: Another empire already controls the galactic core and has reshaped the galaxy.
£trigger_yes£ Has constructed the §Y$galactic_crucible_0$§! Megastructure and upgraded it to a §Y$galactic_crucible_1$§!
£trigger_no£ Has constructed the §Y$galactic_crucible_0$§! Megastructure and upgraded it to a §Y$galactic_crucible_1$§!

entries.zh: §Y$entropy_crystals$§!标志受控能量不稳定化领域的突破。掌控有此不稳定资源，我们能重塑星系秩序。
entries.en: §Y$entropy_crystals$§! mark a breakthrough in controlled energy destabilization. With this volatile resource at our command, we can reshape the galactic order itself.
Allows the accumulation of £entropy_crystals£ §Y$entropy_crystals$§! by completing §HCrisis Objectives§!.

entries.zh: 将§Y$entropy_crystals$§!合成融入工业，实现对不稳定资源的更高效利用，使技术重点契合战略目标。
entries.en: Integrating §Y$entropy_crystals$§! synthesis into our industry allows for more efficient use of this volatile resource, aligning our technical focus with strategic goals.

entries.zh: 这座计划中的熔炉将成为利用恒星熵能的核心引擎。它能够将熵能结晶化并实现传输，将成为我们炽热力量的象征，照耀整个星际。
entries.en: This proposed Crucible would serve as a central engine for harnessing stellar entropy. With the ability to crystallize and transport it, the Crucible could become a beacon of our fiery power, spreading it across the stars.

entries.zh: $entropy_conduit_plural$对现阶段实力扩张至关重要。提升熔炉产出将加快向辉煌燃烧未来迈进。
entries.en: $entropy_conduit_plural$ are vital to expanding our power at this stage. Increasing Crucible output will accelerate our march toward a brighter, burning future.

entries.zh:
§H$UNLOCKS_SHIP_TYPE$：§!$entropy_conduit$
—§Y$entropy_conduit_plural$$LENS_FLARE_BEAM$§!由§Y$galactic_crucible_4$§!自动产生并飞赴邻近恒星系。
—目标恒星系内殖民地获得加成。
—装备£ship_xl_slot£§Y§!武器，命中敌人可使其瘫痪数日。
entries.en:
§H$UNLOCKS_SHIP_TYPE$:§! $entropy_conduit$ 
- §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§! are automatically created by the §Y$galactic_crucible_4$§! and will travel to nearby star systems. 
- Colonies within a targeted system receive bonuses. 
- Are equipped with the £ship_xl_slot£ §Y$LENS_FLARE_BEAM$§! weapon, which disables enemies on impact for several days.

entries.zh: 成为点燃星系的火花，无暇犹豫或顾虑繁文缛节，不能再浪费时间改造各种系统。为实现目标，必须大幅提升建造能力。
entries.en: Being the spark that ignites the galaxy leaves no time for second-guessing or bureaucracy. We can't afford to lose time remodelling countless systems. To achieve our goals, we must dramatically increase our construction capacity.

entries.zh: 有时，单靠努力还不够。需要将技术推向新的高度，释放其真正潜能。现在是时候放宽安全限制，最大化产出。
entries.en: Sometimes, pushing harder isn't enough. We need to take our technology to the next level and exploit its full potential. It's time to minimize safeguards and maximize output.

entries.zh: 这些舰艇配备尖端技术，将不稳定的热流转换为定向的毁灭性能量，将敌人化为焦炭。
entries.en: Equipped with cutting-edge technology, these vessels convert volatile heat flux into directed annihilation, reducing our enemies to charred cinders.

entries.zh: 我们构筑的乌托邦不容任何异议。任何抵抗力量都将迎来母星的火焰洗礼。
entries.en: The utopia we envision leaves no room for opposition to our goals. Any who try to stop us will quickly learn that resistance will be met with a rain of fire upon their homeworlds.

entries.zh:
§H解锁环境改造：§!$pc_volcanic$
§H解锁轰炸姿态：§!$bombardment_firestorm$
我们的$entropy_conduit_plural$目前通过散热保持稳定。若将热量排放至周围空间，$entropy_conduit_plural$就会成为毁灭敌人的利器。
entries.en: Our $entropy_conduit_plural$ currently dissipate massive heat to remain stable. By venting that heat into surrounding space, we could turn the $entropy_conduit_plural$ into devastating weapons against our enemies.

entries.zh: §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!对敌方舰船和空间站造成被动伤害。\n\n
entries.en: §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§! deal passive damage to hostile ships and stations. \n\n

entries.zh: 将§Y$entropy_crystals$§!用于军用科技，解锁无可匹敌的推进系统。舰船将如烈焰般穿梭恒星。
entries.en: Harnessing §Y$entropy_crystals$§! in military tech unlocks propulsion systems of unparalleled power. Our ships will blaze across the stars like never before.

entries.zh: 星系部分地区以前不在我们的掌控之下，不过这种情况即将结束。不久，我方$entropy_conduit_plural$将遍布群星，精准摧毁一切胆敢反抗的力量。
entries.en: There was a period when parts of the galaxy lay beyond our grasp. That illusion is ending. Soon, swarms of our $entropy_conduit_plural$ will saturate the stars, bringing calibrated devastation to all who oppose us.

entries.zh: §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!自动跨越边界进入地方领地。\n\n
entries.en: §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§! automatically cross the border into enemy territory. \n\n

entries.zh: 星系诸势力正联合对抗我们，必须进行全面动员。每位公民均须为能源战线奉献力量，共同燃起我方圣权崛起的火焰。
entries.en: As the galaxy consolidates against us, mobilization becomes imperative. Every citizen must now contribute to sustaining the energy front, fanning the flames of our ascendancy.

entries.zh: 枪管如即将吞没星系的火风暴般炽热，这些大型舰船将构成保卫熔炉的防御主力。
entries.en: With gun barrels as hot as the firestorm that is about to engulf the galaxy, these large ships will make up the bulk of our defensive forces around the Crucible.

entries.zh: 恒星外层的熵能活动增强导致恒星发出的辐射量激增，使整个恒星系加速升温。
entries.en: Increasing the entropic activity in a star's outer shell causes the star to pour forth a swell of radiation. This is causing entire systems to heat up more rapidly.

entries.zh:
§Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!随所控恒星系数量增加而增强。

$hyperthermia_map_perc$
entries.en:
§Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§! become stronger dependent on the amount of captured systems.

$hyperthermia_map_perc$

entries.zh: 星系的§G20%§!：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—$entropy_conduit_plural$向周围殖民地施加破坏度$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—受影响的殖民地会缓慢损失£pop£$POPS$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—只影响非§Y嗜热§!物种帝国$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—所需恒星系：§Y[root.hyperthermia_own_systems_var]§!/§Y[root.hyperthermia_systems_var]§!
entries.en: §G20%§! of the galaxy: $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $entropy_conduit_plural$ deal devastation to nearby colonies $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Affected colonies will slowly lose £pop£ $POPS$ $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Only affects empires of non-§YThermophile§! species $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Required systems: §Y[root.hyperthermia_own_systems_var]§!/§Y[root.hyperthermia_systems_var]§!

entries.zh: 弹药设计革新：标准军备增添微型熵核，撞击瞬间释放不稳定的热能冲击，杀伤力显著增强。
entries.en: A refinement in munitions design: standard ordnance is now augmented with micro-scale entropy cores, releasing destabilized thermal surges upon impact. The result is markedly enhanced destruction.

entries.zh: 将$entropy_crystals$生产整合入基础设施，使我们充分发挥技术优势，最大限度利用这种不稳定新资源。
entries.en: Integrating $entropy_crystals$ production into our infrastructure allows us to fully harness our technical prowess, and exploit this volatile new resource to its fullest potential.
We have never seen this type of formation before

entries.zh: 该恒星系包含一个通往$DEST|Y$的§Y虫洞§!
entries.en: This system contains a §YWormhole§! connected to $DEST|Y$

entries.zh: 该恒星系内包含一个§R未探索的§!§Y虫洞§!
热力统治的帝国推崇能量、熵与恒星之火。他们不以征服为名，而是以火热雕刻星系，灼烧万物。
entries.en: A Thermarchic empire is ruled by an ideology that exalts energy, entropy, and stellar fire. They do not conquer - they cauterize, sculpting the galaxy with heat and will.

entries.zh: 该结构利用强引力梯度，在分子层面分解废料，将其转化为可结晶的熵等离子体以备储存与利用。
entries.en: This structure exploits strong gravitational gradients to shear apart waste material on a molecular level, creating an entropic plasma that can be crystallized for further use.

entries.zh: 本地恒星大气突发剧变，诱发全恒星系范围的强烈太阳耀斑。对他者而言这是灾难，对我们却是繁荣兴盛的机遇。
entries.en: The local star's atmosphere is undergoing rapid changes, causing a system-wide barrage of blazing solar flares. While this is catastrophic for others, it is perfect for us to thrive.
Will slowly turn the targeted star into a §Y$pc_m_giant_star$§!.\n\n$TERRAFORM_ORDER_CLICK_DESC$

entries.zh: 借助结晶熵的叠加能量潜力，小型恒星可成为巨大的红巨星。
entries.en: Using the compounding energy potential of Crystallized Entropy, lesser stars can be expanded into mighty Red Giants.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$轨道上的巨型结构阻碍转变。
该恒星可进行环境改造。

entries.en: Conduit Station has to be in orbit.

entries.zh: 恒星系热量上升促进火山活动，利于推进火热使命。应优先殖民§Y火山星球§!，抢占先机。\n\n每年提供被动§Y$entropy_crystals$§!收益，随§Y$pc_volcanic$§!殖民地数量增长。
entries.en: Rising system heat fuels increased volcanism, perfect for advancing our fiery mission. We should prioritize colonizing §YVolcanic Worlds§! to stay ahead.\n\nProvides passive §Y$entropy_crystals$§! income each year, scaling with the number of §Y$pc_volcanic$§! colonies.

entries.zh: 扩展星体火山活动推动熵晶经济。依靠环境改造技术，可在任何选定行星引发持久火山活动。\n\n环境改造行星变为§Y$pc_volcanic$§!。
entries.en: Spreading planetary volcanism across the galaxy will fuel our Entropy Crystal economy. With the right terraforming techniques, we can trigger sustained volcanic activity wherever we choose.\n\nTerraform a planet into a §Y$pc_volcanic$§!

entries.zh: 我们应该优先在红色恒星周边运作。其广阔辐射表面适合热能采集。\n\n每月提供被动§Y$entropy_crystals$§!收入，随我们占有的§Y$pc_m_star$§!或§Y$pc_m_giant_star$§!增长。
entries.en: We should prioritize operating in systems around red stars. Their vast emission surfaces are ideal for harvesting thermal energy.\n\nProvides passive §Y$entropy_crystals$§! income each month, scaling with each §Y$pc_m_star$§! or §Y$pc_m_giant_star$§! in systems we occupy.

entries.zh: 通过熵晶驱动，令恒星膨胀为红巨星，助力火热帝国崛起。\n\n经§Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!环境改造的恒星成为§Y$pc_m_giant_star$§!。
entries.en: By channeling Entropy Crystals, we can swell stars into Red Giants, fueling the rise of our blazing new empire.\n\nStars terraformed by §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§! become §Y$pc_m_giant_star$§!

entries.zh: 时机已到，借由火风暴轰击向宿敌彰显我们的绝对霸权，将其星球化为灰烬。\n\n使用§Y$bombardment_firestorm$§!轰炸殖民地，造成§R100%毁灭§!。
entries.en: It is time to teach our rivals the true meaning of supremacy, with a firestorm bombardment that will leave their world in ashes.\n\nBombard a colony with §Y$bombardment_firestorm$§! to inflict §R100% devastation§!

entries.zh: 寒冷温带星球无益。需重塑表面，融化成符合我方需求形态。\n\n使用装备于§Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!和§Y$ember_battleship_plural$§!的£ship_xl_slot£§Y$LENS_FLARE_BEAM$§!武器，轰炸敌方星球。
entries.en: Cold and temperate worlds serve us no purpose. We must reshape them, by melting their surfaces into forms more suited to our needs.\n\nUse the £ship_xl_slot£ §Y$LENS_FLARE_BEAM$§! weapon, equipped on §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§! and §Y$ember_battleship_plural$§!, to bombard enemy worlds.

entries.zh: 引力离心机助我们搜集更多$entropy_crystals$。\n\n在§Y双星§!、§Y三合星§!或§Y$pc_black_hole$§!建造§!$sm_gravitational_centrifuge$§Y恒星基地建筑。
entries.en: Gravitational Centrifuges will help us gather more $entropy_crystals$. \n\nConstruct the §Y$sm_gravitational_centrifuge$§! starbase building in §Ybinary§!, §Ytrinary§! or §Y$pc_black_hole$§! systems.

entries.zh: $SHIP_GRAPHICS_CRUISER_DESC$\n\n$ember_cruiser$变体通过传导§Y$entropy_crystals$§!将剧烈的热流转变为直接的毁灭。
entries.en: $SHIP_GRAPHICS_CRUISER_DESC$\n\nThe $ember_cruiser$ variant channels §Y$entropy_crystals$§! to convert volatile heat flux into directed annihilation.

entries.zh: $SHIP_GRAPHICS_BATTLESHIP_DESC$\n\n$ember_battleship$变体是在§Y$galactic_crucible_4$§!之中筑成，可以装备§Y$LENS_FLARE_BEAM$§!武器。
entries.en: $SHIP_GRAPHICS_BATTLESHIP_DESC$\n\nThe $ember_battleship$ variant is forged in the §Y$galactic_crucible_4$§! and can equip the §Y$LENS_FLARE_BEAM$§! weapon.

entries.zh: 该武器发射的光束经精密校准，能够干扰敌方的关键控制系统，为无抗力打击创造短暂窗口。
entries.en: This weapon's beam is calibrated to disrupt critical control systems, allowing a limited window of opportunity for unopposed assaults.

entries.zh: §Y使目标瘫痪§!，无法移动或反击，持续时间为§G7天§!。
entries.en: §YDisables§! the target for §G7§! days, making it unable to move or fire back.

entries.zh: $galactic_crucible_4$的基础结构，用以支持并引导整座空间站的建造。
entries.en: The foundational framework of a $galactic_crucible_4$, built to support and guide the rest of the station's construction.

entries.zh: 这座庞大空间站虹吸宿主恒星能量，驱动自动化船坞生产§Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!，在那里，正建造着足以改写恒星命运的舰艇。
entries.en: This vast station siphons energy from its host star, powering automated shipyards that produce §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!; vessels capable of reshaping stellar destinies.

entries.zh: 核心设施完工后，$galactic_crucible_4$成为一座功能齐全的空间站。熵晶系统的建设已启动。
entries.en: With its core infrastructure complete, the $galactic_crucible_4$ is now a functional station. Construction of the entropy crystallization systems is already underway.

entries.zh: $galactic_crucible_4$现完全运作，准备扩展部署§Y$entropy_crystals$§!。未来所有升级均基于此基础。\n§H完成特殊项目以解锁下一阶段。§!
entries.en: The $galactic_crucible_4$ is now fully operational and ready to expand deployment of §Y$entropy_crystals$§!. All future upgrades will depend on this foundation.\n§HComplete the Special Project to unlock the next stage.§!

entries.zh: 扩张中的$galactic_crucible_4$现具备模块化熵系统，设计支持无缝重构与扩展。技术人员可提升容量并降低低效。
entries.en: The expanding $galactic_crucible_4$ now features modular entropic systems, designed for seamless reconfiguration and growth. Technicians can increase its capacity while minimizing inefficiencies.

entries.zh: $galactic_crucible_4$全线武装、全力运转，准备将炽烈净火撒遍星域。熵通量系统已达理论峰值效率。
entries.en: Fully armed and operational, the $galactic_crucible_4$ stands ready to unleash its fiery scouring across the galaxy. Entropic flux systems now operate at peak theoretical efficiency.

entries.zh: $galactic_crucible_4$已完成不可逆重构，可防止高能失控造成危险，确保帝国稳定并持续成为繁荣的能源源泉。
entries.en: The $galactic_crucible_4$ has been irreversibly re-engineered to prevent dangerously high energy output. It will remain a stable and secure source of prosperity for the empire.

entries.zh: 废弃的造船厂，曾经为实现失落帝国的炽热野心而建。
entries.en: A ruined shipyard, once forged to serve the fiery ambitions of a fallen empire.

entries.zh: 广袤废墟仍闪烁着不规则的热斑脉动。
entries.en: This vast ruin still radiates with flickering pockets of heat, pulsing unpredictably across the shattered remains.

entries.zh: $galactic_crucible_4$自动建造$entropy_conduit_plural$。它们将前往可转变为§Y$pc_m_giant_star$§!的恒星。
entries.en: The $galactic_crucible_4$ constructs $entropy_conduit_plural$ automatically. They will make their way to a star that can be turned into a §Y$pc_m_giant_star$§!.

entries.zh: 稳定且适度地产出结晶熵。\n
entries.en: Produces a steady, modest supply of Crystallized Entropy.\n

entries.zh: 利用大量储能，提高导管建造速度。\n
entries.en: Uses massive energy reserves to boost Conduit construction.\n

entries.zh: 大量合金投资，提高结晶熵产量。\n
entries.en: Heavy investment of alloys allows for Crystallized Entropy to be produced at a higher rate.\n

entries.zh: $galactic_crucible_4$可为附近舰船大量供应备用能量，最大化防御舰队战力。\n
entries.en: The $galactic_crucible_4$ can be used to supply nearby ships with ample amounts of spare energy, maximizing the fighting strength of defensive fleets.\n

entries.zh: 我们已决定以烈焰开辟未来，准备将整个星系没于烈火之中。
entries.en: We have decided that the future is wreathed in flame, and are moving to set the entire galaxy on fire.

entries.zh: 火焰长久以来在我们社会中举足轻重，而今我们能以创新方式驾驭其混沌力量。科学家梦寐以求的能源即将展现，其超越维持现有文明，能助我们跃向星际。\n\n§H效果：§!解锁新£entropy_crystals£§Y$entropy_crystals$§!资源。
entries.en: Fire has long played a significant role in our society, but now we may be able to harness its chaotic power in novel ways. This could be what scientists have long dreamed of: an energy source that goes beyond fueling our current civilization, and can catapult us across the stars.\n\n§HEffect:§! Unlocks the new £entropy_crystals£ §Y$entropy_crystals$§! resource.

entries.zh:
熔炉为我们指明了新路。摒弃愚昧，重塑炽热星系，焚尽拒绝者。

§H效果：§!
—解锁§Y$galactic_crucible_4$§!下一升级。
—§Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!现可转换敌方恒星。
entries.en:
The Crucible has shown us a new path for our species. It would be foolish not to embrace it, and we should suffer no fools. It is time to remake the galaxy in a blazing new image, and burn away anyone who rejects our vision.

§HEffects:§!
- Unlocks the next upgrade of the §Y$galactic_crucible_4$§!.
- §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§! can now convert stars in enemy territory.

entries.zh: 熔炉具备强大能量产出，但并不稳定。若将其性能永久下调至适中水平，既可确保我方长期繁荣，也能避免对星系及邻邦构成威胁，维护地区稳定与善意关系。
entries.en: While the Crucible's power is immense, it is also volatile. If we permanently cripple its capabilities, we will secure a modest source of prosperity for ourselves without endangering the galaxy or losing the goodwill of our neighbors.

entries.zh: 我们对§Y$entropy_crystals$§!的掌控即将开启星系激变。已开通连接星系核心6个恒星系的虫洞。\n若在各恒星系建立§Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!设施，并守护免受干涉，我们即可燃烧整个星系。
entries.en: Our mastery of §Y$entropy_crystals$§! will soon allow us to begin a radical transformation of the galaxy. We have opened wormholes to six systems around the galactic core.\nIf we establish §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§! in each of these, and defend them from anyone who would meddle with our plans, we will be able to set the galaxy itself ablaze.

entries.zh: 当前向星系核辐射的熵能水平达到顶峰时，星系将被燃烧殆尽。
entries.en: The current level of entropy radiating into the galactic core. When it reaches its peak, the galaxy will burn.

entries.zh: 情报显示多国或筹备战争阻止我方计划。若措手不及，计划将夭折。
entries.en: Our intelligence reports that various nations are perhaps preparing for war to foil our plans. If we meet them unprepared, our undertaking will fail before it even begins.

entries.zh: 时机已到，一场席卷星系的浩大战争即将爆发。
entries.en: The time has come. An inevitable conflict is about to engulf the galaxy in a war of epic proportions.

entries.zh: 星系接近完全点燃的速度。
entries.en: The speed at which the galaxy is approaching total ignition.

entries.zh: §L我们憧憬着火焰乌托邦，为达成愿景必须清除一切阻碍。第一束火光已升起，必须助长其燃烧，让烈焰蔓延至星系的每一个角落。§!\n\n$situation_hyperthermia_stats$
entries.en: §LWe envision a blazing utopia, but to create it we must incinerate everything that stands in our way. We've lit the first sparks, and must now stoke the flames until every corner of the galaxy has been consumed.§!\n\n$situation_hyperthermia_stats$

entries.zh: §L§Y[event_target:hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!点燃群星，迎战星系最炽烈的火焰，只有一次机会，如果失败，一切都将化为灰烬。§!\n\n$situation_hyperthermia_stats$
entries.en: §L§Y[event_target:hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§! has set the stars ablaze. It is now our turn to fight the greatest fire the galaxy has ever faced. There are no second chances. If we fail, everything we have achieved will be reduced to ash.§!\n\n$situation_hyperthermia_stats$

entries.zh: 若行动成功，火雨将吞噬整个星系，唯有拥火者能在灰烬中屹立。恒星亦难以幸免；数十亿年后，它将被改造为我们母星的模样。
entries.en: If we succeed, a rain of fire will consume the galaxy, leaving only those who have embraced the heat standing among the ashes. Not even the stars are immune; after billions of years, they will be reshaped in the image of our home star.

entries.zh: 一旦§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!成功，整个星系将化为灰烬，只剩那些嗜热的族群得以存续。
entries.en: If §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§! succeeds, the entire galaxy will be burned to ashes, creating a realm where only Thermophile life forms will survive.

entries.zh:
§Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!占领的星系核心恒星系数量决定每月进度。
$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—少于§Y3§!个：§R-3§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—占领§Y3§!个：§Y0§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—多于§Y3§!个：§G+3§!

当前进度
entries.en:
The amount of Galactic Core systems occupied by §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§! determines the monthly progression. 
$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Less than §Y3§! systems: §R-3§! $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Occupying §Y3§! systems: §Y0§! $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- More than §Y3§! systems: §G+3§! 

Current Progress

entries.zh: 错过即永远。我们必须成功，否则一切成就皆付东流。
entries.en: It's now or never. We must succeed, or risk losing all we have achieved.

entries.zh: 此帝国是星系稳定的隐患。全方位应对已非可选方案，而是唯一出路。
entries.en: This empire represents an existential threat to galactic stability. Full engagement is no longer a choice, but a necessity.

entries.zh:
我方[GetScientistPlural]报告发现一项全新技术，可将熵锁定于高能晶体阵列中储存。此§Y$entropy_crystals$§!可存运大量热能，适用于工业、经济与星际用途。

模拟结果表明，此能量可用于环境改造行星气候，使其升温，甚至推动恒星向红巨星阶段演化。理论上，还可回收星系中逸散的熵能并转化为热量，进而系统推动全星系热膨胀。

§H特殊项目立项：§!§Y$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY$§!
entries.en:
Our [GetScientistPlural] report a novel method for harvesting and storing entropy by binding it into a high-energy crystalline matrix. This §Y$entropy_crystals$§! can store and transport substantial thermal energy, applicable across industrial, economic, and interstellar operations.

Modeling suggests that it might be used to terraform planets into hotter climates, or even in accelerating stellar evolution into red giants. In principle, stray entropy from across the galaxy could be reclaimed and converted into usable heat, driving compounding thermal expansion on a galactic scale.

§HIssues Special Project:§! §Y$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY$§!

entries.zh:
我方[GetScientistPlural]分析曾点燃红巨星的§Y$entropy_crystals$§!，一度险毁文明。现已可被重新设计改造，使其适用于工业体系、经济结构以及恒星级能源运输。

模拟结果显示，此能量可用于环境改造行星气候，使其升温，甚至推动恒星向红巨星阶段演化。理论上，还可回收星系中逸散的熵能并转化为热量，进而恒星系推动热膨胀。

§H特殊项目立项：§!§Y$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY$§!
entries.en:
Our [GetScientistPlural] have analyzed the §Y$entropy_crystals$§! once used to ignite a Red Giant, an act that nearly ended our civilization before it began. We can now re-engineer this volatile substance to bind and transport vast thermal energy for industrial, economic, and stellar-scale use.

Simulations suggest it may enable terraforming into hotter climates or trigger stellar evolution into red giants. In theory, ambient galactic entropy could be reclaimed and converted into heat, driving systemic thermal expansion.

§HIssues Special Project:§! §Y$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY$§!

entries.zh:
我们完成了第一座采集能量并转化为§Y$entropy_crystals$§!的基础设施。这种晶体能够储存海量热能，已使我们的各行各业在能以远超以往一切技术的效率存储、运输能量。

得益于其庞大的辐射面积与热输出功率，红巨星是最理想的作业场所，而我们已经准备好在所掌控的任何恒星系里部署这种技术设施了。

技术人员正调整工艺使其适用于工业化生产，探索利用环境熵合成$entropy_crystals$。伴随这种新经济的熊熊燃起，财富和力量也随之兴盛起来。[GetScientistPlural]们已经在研究如何进一步扩大生产规模了。

§H$UNLOCKS_MEGASTRUCTURE$：§!§Y$galactic_crucible_0$§!
entries.en:
We have completed our first working infrastructure for harvesting energy and converting it into §Y$entropy_crystals$§!. These crystals hold immense thermal energy and already enable our industry to store and transport power far more efficiently than conventional methods.

Red Giants, thanks to their vast emission surfaces and thermal output, are ideal for this process, and we're ready to deploy the technology in any system under our control.

Our technicians have also begun adapting the process for industrial use, experimenting with ways to synthesize $entropy_crystals$ by harnessing ambient entropy. With this new economy igniting, wealth and power are sure to follow. Our [GetScientistPlural] are already researching how to scale production further.

§H$UNLOCKS_MEGASTRUCTURE$:§! §Y$galactic_crucible_0$§!

entries.zh:
现有的§Y$entropy_crystals$§!样本让我们在无需危及母星也能进行采集与合成。这种晶体能够储存海量热能，已使我们的各行各业在能以远超以往一切技术的效率存储、运输能量。

得益于其庞大的辐射面积与热输出功率，红巨星是最理想的作业场所，而我们已经准备好在所掌控的任何恒星系里部署这种技术设施了。

技术人员正调整工艺使其适用于工业化生产，探索利用环境熵合成$entropy_crystals$。伴随这种新经济的熊熊燃起，财富和力量也随之兴盛起来。[GetScientistPlural]们已经在研究如何进一步扩大生产规模了。

§H$UNLOCKS_MEGASTRUCTURE$：§!§Y$galactic_crucible_0$§!
entries.en:
With our existing samples of §Y$entropy_crystals$§!, we can harvest and synthesize them without endangering our home star. These crystals hold immense thermal energy, allowing our industry to store and transport power far more efficiently than conventional methods.

Red Giants, thanks to their vast emission surfaces and thermal output, are ideal for this process, and we're ready to deploy the technology in any system under our control.

Our technicians have also begun adapting the process for industrial use, experimenting with ways to synthesize $entropy_crystals$ by harnessing ambient entropy. With this new economy igniting, wealth and power are sure to follow. Our [GetScientistPlural] are already researching how to scale production further.

§H$UNLOCKS_MEGASTRUCTURE$:§! §Y$galactic_crucible_0$§!
Use a $constructor$ to build the §Y$galactic_crucible_0$§! around a star.
Order the drones to begin construction.
Use a $constructor$ to build the §Y$galactic_crucible_0$§! around a star.

entries.zh: 我们踏上点燃星系的道路，但自身必须做好面对高温的准备。适应更高温度将助我们在这炽热的新未来中繁荣。
entries.en: We embark on our path to set the galaxy aflame, but our own forms must be prepared to face the heat. Adapting our population to higher temperatures will help us thrive in our fiery new future.

entries.zh: 在全力逆转恒星变化的同时，我们自身必须做好面对高温的准备。适应更高温度将助我们在这炽热的新未来中繁荣。
entries.en: As we work tirelessly to reverse our star's changes, our own forms must be prepared to face the heat. Adapting our population to higher temperatures will help us thrive alongside our star's fiery new future.

entries.zh:
$galactic_crucible_1$可部署§Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!可引导并强化恒星的熵能，一旦发送，它们就会回收并强化恒星的能量输出。使其演化为红巨星，从而将恒星系加热至支撑帝国扩张基础设施的水平。

此类§Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!能够定期生产并自主运作，目前仅限于我方领土，但未来有望扩展至整个星系，推动帝国持续增长。

§H可升级的巨型结构如下：§!§Y$galactic_crucible_2$§!
entries.en:
The $galactic_crucible_1$ is now ready to deploy §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!: automated systems designed to channel and amplify stellar entropy. Once dispatched, they'll recycle and intensify a star's energy output, converting it into a Red Giant, heating entire systems to support our empire's expanding infrastructure.

These §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§! can be produced at regular intervals and operate autonomously for our convenience. For now, they'll remain within our territory, but in time, it may serve us to let them spread across the galaxy. After all, our empire never stops growing.

§HMegastructure Upgrade Available:§! §Y$galactic_crucible_2$§!

entries.zh: 迫切需要征服更多恒星。
entries.en: We need to conquer more stars.

entries.zh:
§Y$entropy_crystals$§!研究揭示惊天秘密：在高浓度下，该物质可被用于制造足以摧毁整颗行星的武器。若我方掌握此力量，整个星系或将归于我手。

但若追求军事应用，将破坏与邻邦脆弱信任。谁又能保证此武器不会反噬自身？

若望证我方意图，必须公然削弱$galactic_crucible_2$，禁止生产此类武器。否则，终会有人将其用于杀戮，即我方或他人。

§H该抉择将解锁特殊项目§!。
entries.en:
Our continued research into §Y$entropy_crystals$§! has unveiled a chilling possibility: when highly concentrated, they can power weapons of unimaginable scale, capable of devastating entire planets. With such power, the galaxy could fall under our mercy.

But exploring these military applications would shatter what little trust remains between us and our neighbors. And who's to say such weapons couldn't one day be turned against us?

Empty words of peace will not suffice. If we wish to prove our intentions, we must publicly cripple the $galactic_crucible_2$, ensuring it can never produce such weaponry. Otherwise, it's only a matter of time before this technology is weaponized, by us, or by someone else.

§HThis decision unlocks a Special Project§!

entries.zh: 阻止接触危机等级$crisis_hyperthermia_level_4$。\n\n§H特殊项目立项：§!§Y$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY_GOOD$§!将§Y$galactic_crucible_2$§!转变为§Y$galactic_crucible_5$§!。
entries.en: Prevents access to Crisis level $crisis_hyperthermia_level_4$. \n\n§HIssues Special Project:§! §Y$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY_GOOD$§! to turn the §Y$galactic_crucible_2$§! into a §Y$galactic_crucible_5$§!.

entries.zh:
我方对§Y$entropy_crystals$§!及§Y$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY_EVIL$项目§!之调查确认毁灭性武器潜力属实。掌握此等力量后，外交礼节将不再约束我们的行动。

由于其激进的军事化应用，$galactic_crucible_3$扩张可以加速。武器越早解锁，我们越早称霸。

§H巨型结构升级可用：§!§Y$galactic_crucible_4$§!
entries.en:
Our investigation into §Y$entropy_crystals$§! and the §Y$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY_EVIL$ Project§! has confirmed what we suspected: the potential for devastating weaponry is real. With such power in our hands, we no longer need to temper ourselves for the sake of diplomatic niceties.

The $galactic_crucible_3$'s expansion will accelerate, with special focus on its more... aggressive applications. The sooner we unlock these weapons, the less the galaxy's opinions will matter.

§HMegastructure Upgrade Available:§! §Y$galactic_crucible_4$§!

entries.zh: 我们必须为战争做好准备。
entries.en: We must ready ourselves for war.
- The §Y$galactic_crucible_4$§! expansion should be a priority.\n- $unlocks_conduit_damage$

entries.zh: 我们的对手将成为火焰的引燃物。
entries.en: Our rivals shall be kindling for the fire.
- The §Y$galactic_crucible_4$§! expansion should be a priority.\n- $unlocks_conduit_damage$

entries.zh:
$galactic_crucible_3$已被成功削弱，确保其不再能被扩展或用于破坏性目的。虽然失去了其全部潜能令人遗憾，但继续那条道路将带来灾难风险及所有外交关系的崩溃。

幸运的是，即使功能受限，$galactic_crucible_5$仍将是强大且繁荣的能源来源。我们在越过界限前选择了退步，保障了与星海共同体合作的未来，同时依然从这项非凡科学中获益。

§H巨型结构升级可用：§!§Y$galactic_crucible_5$§!
entries.en:
The $galactic_crucible_3$ has been successfully hobbled, ensuring it can no longer be expanded or repurposed for destructive ends. While the loss of its full potential is regrettable, continuing down that path would have risked catastrophe, and the collapse of all diplomatic ties.

Fortunately, even in its limited form, the $galactic_crucible_5$ will remain a powerful source of energy and prosperity. We've stepped back before crossing a line, securing a future where we can collaborate with the galactic community while still benefiting from this remarkable science.

§HMegastructure Upgrade Available:§! §Y$galactic_crucible_5$§!

entries.zh: 我们对§Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!的持续研究以及将恒星转化为红巨星的研究表明，我们或许能够扩大行动规模，直接使银河系核心过热，从而在整个银河触发热级联，把它改造成对我们更为适宜的环境。\n\n我们已确定六个核心周边星系，可作为此计划的作业枢纽。这些星系位于星系超空间航路网络之外，但相关稳定虫洞的构建工作正紧锣密鼓进行。
entries.en: Our ongoing research into §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§! and transforming stars into Red Giants suggests we may be able to scale up our operations to overheat the Galactic Core itself, triggering a thermal cascade across the entire Galaxy, thus transforming it into a much more hospitable place for us.\n\nWe have identified six systems surrounding the core that could serve as operational hubs for this endeavor. These systems lie beyond the galactic hyperlane network, but efforts are underway to generate stable wormholes and establish access.

entries.zh: 只有我们适合在烈焰中生存。
entries.en: We are the only ones fit to survive the flames.

entries.zh: 其他物种将试图反对我们。准备星系战争。
entries.en: Other species will try to oppose us. Prepare for Galactic war.

entries.zh: 整个星系将在熊熊烈焰中归一。
entries.en: The whole galaxy will blaze in harmony.

entries.zh: 其他物种将试图反对我们。准备星系战争。
entries.en: Other species will try to oppose us. Prepare for Galactic war.

entries.zh:
$galactic_crucible_4$现已全面武装并投入运行。随着虫洞通道完工，我们已取得通往围绕星系核心六个集结星系的通道。

我们开始进行核心过热工作。其它帝国可能察觉并试图进入这些恒星系，但暂时我们占有优势，核心已屈服于我们的意志。

§H使用虫洞保护星系核心恒星系§!
entries.en:
The $galactic_crucible_4$ is now fully armed and operational. With wormhole tunnels completed, we've secured access to all six staging systems around the Galactic Core.

Our work to overheat the Core can begin. Other empires may detect our activity and attempt to reach these systems, but for now, we hold the advantage, and the core bends to our will.

§HUse the wormhole to secure the Galactic Core systems§!

entries.zh: 开始在核心恒星系中部署。
entries.en: Begin installation in the core systems.

entries.zh: 在六个星系核心恒星系中部署§Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§!，我们就能一次性使整个星系过热。必须着手准备。
entries.en: Deploying §Y$entropy_conduit_plural$§! in the six Galactic Core systems will let us overheat the entire galaxy at once. We must begin preparations.

entries.zh: 我们的未来因火焰而光明。
entries.en: Our future is bright with fire.

entries.zh: 对立帝国已强行开启通往我们靠近星系核心集结地的超空间航路。随着我们持续使核心超热，必须为抵抗做好准备。\n\n但我们不会被阻止。宇宙中寒冷黑暗将被驱散，取而代之的是我们崛起未来的炽热辉煌。
entries.en: Rival empires have forced open hyperlanes to our staging grounds near the galactic core. As we continue to superheat the core, we must prepare for resistance.\n\nBut we will not be stopped. The cold dark of space will be scoured away, replaced by the blazing glory of our ascendant future.

entries.zh: 他们永远无法扑灭我们。
entries.en: They will never snuff us out.

entries.zh: 让他们前赴后继于熊熊烈焰中吧。
entries.en: Let them hurl themselves into our incinerating blaze.

entries.zh:
星系核心开始躁动。环绕超大质量黑洞的熵水平激增，向附近恒星系释放出热辐射波动。

正当恐慌蔓延时，一支由多星球勇敢科学家组成的小组揭示了连接核心周边六个恒星系的新近超空间航路。这些恒星系据悉拥有由§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!运作的设施，正在积极使核心过热。这种鲁莽干预将引发星系级火风暴，将毁灭所有未能阻止纵火狂野心的人。

若想生存，我们必须突破这些恒星系，夺取控制权。危机已至——温度仍在攀升。
entries.en:
The galactic core has begun to stir. Entropy levels around the supermassive black hole are spiking, casting waves of thermal radiation into nearby systems.

Just as panic sets in, a team of brave scientists, drawn from many worlds, has unveiled newly-formed hyperlanes connecting to six systems encircling the core. These systems, it seems, house facilities operated by §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!, which are actively superheating the core. This reckless tampering threatens to ignite a cascading firestorm across the galaxy, incinerating all who fail to stop their pyromaniac ambitions.

If we wish to survive, we must breach these systems and wrest control from their grasp. The crisis is here - and the temperature is still rising.

entries.zh: §L一场无与伦比的危机即将席卷我们的星系。唯有新成立联盟的联合力量才能拯救我们。§!\n\n将组成反对危机的§Y联盟§!帝国，引发星系范围冲突。我们将§R对§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!宣战§!。
entries.en: §LA crisis of unparalleled proportions is about to engulf our galaxy. Only the combined strength of a newly formed alliance can save us.§! \n\nWill form a §Ycoalition§! of empires opposing the crisis, resulting in a galaxy-wide conflict. We will §Rdeclare war§! against the §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: §L危机时刻，每个物种都应该自救。我们拥有独立解决的能力。§!
entries.en: §LIn times of crisis, it is every species for themselves. We have the strength to resolve this on our own.§!

entries.zh: §L§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!的方法符合我们新星系的愿景。契合于此，我们或可幸免于看似灾难的全力冲击。§!
entries.en: §LThe methods of §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§! conform to our vision of a renewed galaxy. In light of this alignment, we may be spared the full force of what others will deem a catastrophe.§!

entries.zh: §L玩火的帝国司空见惯。此动荡终将过去，置身事外就好了。§!
entries.en: §LAn empire playing with fire is hardly a novelty. This upheaval will pass, as all things do. There is little reason to involve ourselves.§!

entries.zh:
历史上伟大变革常伴随牺牲。然而，星海共同体将我方的工作视为不必要的威胁，并以联合军事同盟名义对我们动员。

其目标直指灭绝，我们别无选择：任何接近星系核心或$galactic_crucible_4$的行为都会遭到压倒性武力的回应。

我们的愿景已点燃恒星。让反对者迎战我们召唤的风暴吧。

§H守住星系核心恒星系，我们就一定能取得胜利！§!
entries.en:
History's greatest transformations have always demanded sacrifice. Yet the Galactic Community views our work as a threat rather than a necessity. In response, a unified military coalition has mobilized against us.

With extermination their stated goal, we are left with no alternative: any approach toward the Galactic Core or the $galactic_crucible_4$ will be met with overwhelming force.

Our vision has ignited the stars themselves. Let those who oppose it contend with the storm we have summoned.

§HDefend the Galactic Core systems and our victory is assured!§!

entries.zh:
鉴于星系核心局势升级威胁，星海共同体联合采取行动反对§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!，其激进加热星系行为威胁所有已知生命。

若任其为所欲为，无数文明将陷灭绝危机。所谓§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!已与必要联合的联盟成直接对立。

战斗已发动，数万亿生命岌岌可危。

§H夺取星系核心恒星系，否则将失去一切！§!
entries.en:
In light of escalating threats at the galactic core, the Galactic Community has enacted a unified response against §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!, whose radical efforts to raise the galactic temperature endanger all known life.

Should these ambitions proceed unchecked, countless civilizations face extinction. The so-called §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§! now stands in direct opposition to a coalition united by necessity.

The battle has begun, and trillions of lives hang in the balance.

§HCapture the Galactic Core systems or all will be lost!§!

entries.zh:
火风暴即将爆发。星系核心将喷发，铲除敌人并确立我们对群星的统治。

然而星系拒绝接纳我们辉煌未来。通过新开超空间航路，他们密谋入侵集结地，颠覆我们的一切。目的何在？仅为守护那阴冷停滞的黑暗？

我们绝不能允许。必须坚守核心线，直至火风暴点燃，将他们化为灰烬。
entries.en:
A cascading firestorm impends. Soon, the galactic core will erupt, cleansing our enemies and cementing our dominion over the stars.

But the galaxy refuses to embrace our radiant future. Through the newly-forged hyperlanes, they plot to invade our staging grounds and undo everything we've built. For what? To preserve their cold, stagnant darkness?

We cannot allow them to interfere. We must hold the line at the core, until the firestorm ignites and reduces them to ash.

entries.zh:
星系核心持续升温，§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!的纵火狂热助推火势。按此速度，火风暴将消灭所有反对者，几乎灭绝星系所有生命。

不可沟通妥协。若想生存，必须攻破源头：星系核心恒星系，那里火力最旺。唯有如此，§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!方能阻止。

整个星系的命运悬于一线。是时候告诉§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!，玩火者……必将自食其果。
entries.en:
The galactic core grows ever hotter, driven by §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]'s§! fanatical obsession with igniting the stars. At this pace, their firestorm will annihilate all opposition, and purge the galaxy of nearly all life.

They cannot be reasoned with. If we are to survive, we must strike at the source: the Galactic Core systems, where their power burns brightest. Only then can §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§! be stopped.

The fate of the entire galaxy hangs in the balance. It's time to show §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§! that those who play with fire... will burn.

entries.zh: 必须控制六大核心恒星系才能获胜。
entries.en: We must maintain control of the six core systems to achieve victory.
We need to snuff them out for good.

entries.zh: 必须袭击六大核心恒星系，摧毁§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!的导管，否则我们将被焚毁。
entries.en: We must attack the six core systems and destroy §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!'s conduits there, or we will be incinerated.

entries.zh:
从星系核心到最外围的恒星，我们煽起了胜利火焰。火风暴已将敌人烧成灰烬。他们缺乏勇气与远见，无法拥抱我们所缔造的辉煌未来。星系属于我们。

在这火与怒的新秩序里，行星被岩浆与光芒熔煮，由红巨星的火焰温度点亮。熵能涌流穿梭于每一恒星系，由我们采集、塑造。帝国日益富裕强盛……不可阻挡。

我们吞噬并重塑星系，成为虚空中熊熊燃烧的统治灯塔。或许有朝一日，我们还将引燃其他星系。
entries.en:
We have fanned the flames of victory from the galactic core to the outermost stars. The firestorm has reduced our enemies to ash. They lacked the vision, the courage, to embrace the glorious future we claimed. The galaxy is ours.

In this new order of fire and fury, planets boil with magma and light, set aglow by the swelling heat of red giants. Entropy surges through every system, ours to harvest and bend to our will. With each passing day, our empire grows richer, stronger... unstoppable.

We have consumed the galaxy and remade it as a blazing beacon of our dominion in the void. And one day, perhaps, we'll cast other galaxies onto the pyre.

entries.zh: 这片新星系，我们志在必得。
entries.en: This new galaxy is ours for the taking.

entries.zh: 终将所有火焰融为一体。
entries.en: In the end, all fires join to become one.

entries.zh: 我们的火热母星不容弱者拖累。
entries.en: Our fiery home needs no tepid weaklings.
Our endurance has finally been rewarded.

entries.zh: 终于，我们将寒冷与黑暗驱逐出星系。
entries.en: At last, we've banished the cold dark from this galaxy.

entries.zh: 最终，我们可怜的对手化为灰烬。
entries.en: At last, our miserable rivals are reduced to ash.

entries.zh: 随着§H[crucible_system.GetName]§!恒星系被占领，我们的军团夺取了那座环绕恒星建造的$galactic_crucible_4$。\n\n这座巨型建造物的沦陷，宣告了其缔造者以武力称霸星系的美梦破碎。
entries.en: With the capture of the §H[crucible_system.GetName]§! system, our forces have also taken control of the $galactic_crucible_4$ that was being built around the local star. \n\nThe loss of this megastructure shatters any remaining hope its creators had of taking over the galaxy by force.
The §Y$galactic_crucible_4$§! will be ruined beyond repair.
We can make use of this.
Turns the §Y$galactic_crucible_4$§! into a §Y$galactic_crucible_5$§! to produce $r_alloys$.

entries.zh: 占领§H[crucible_system.GetName]§!系统揭露了§H[crucible_builders.GetName]§!的阴谋，他们企图通过前所未有的烈焰风暴彻底毁灭整个银河系。\n\n目前，那台可能引发大规模灭绝的机器已被暂停。战争一旦结束，我们应动用剩余资源与兵力，将这座巨型建筑彻底摧毁。
entries.en: Capturing the §H[crucible_system.GetName]§! system unveiled the sinister plans of the §H[crucible_builders.GetName]§!, which included the complete annihilation of the entire galaxy by an unprecedented storm of fire. \n\nFor now, the machine that holds the potential to cause a mass extinction event has been put on hold. As soon as the war ends, we should use our remaining resources and strength to disable this giant megastructure once and for all.

entries.zh: 我们必须尽快结束这场战争！
entries.en: We have to end this war quickly!

entries.zh: 当我们忙于引燃星系时，§Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§!已经将其永久重塑，把恒星变为了武器。\n\n现在，我们终于可以拥抱新的乌托邦，但随着他们对银河控制的加深，我们应密切监视他们的下一步行动。
entries.en: While we were busy igniting the spark that would set the galaxy ablaze, the §Y[hyperthermia_empire.GetName]§! had already transformed stars into weapons, reshaping the galaxy forever. \n\nFor now, we can embrace this newly forged utopia, but we should closely monitor their next moves as they tighten their grip on the galaxy.

entries.zh: 被焚烧的星系扭曲成怪诞的景象，奇点吐出诱人而灼热的波动。若不将其封印，这股炽热会莫名地吸引朝圣者，驱使他们走向最荒凉之地。站在焚光之前的人，愿放下尘世繁芜，只为更接近那纯粹的火焰。
entries.en: Warped by a burning galaxy, this singularity crackles with an alluring heat. Unless carefully sealed, it will inexplicably draw pilgrims, even to the most desolate worlds. Those who stand before it feel compelled to embrace a simpler life... closer to the flames.
\n- §G10%§! or our £physics_research£ §Y$physics_research$§! income will also generate $r_energy$.

entries.zh: —解锁在可殖民星球执行§Y$decision_gh_life_seeding$§!决策，创造新原始文明。
entries.en: - Unlocks the §Y$decision_gh_life_seeding$§! decision on colonizable worlds to create a new primitive civilization.

entries.zh: 我们成功改造星系，导致多数行星物种迅速灭绝。如今，我们得以以自身形态重塑生命，开启新纪元。
entries.en: Our success in reshaping the galaxy has led to the rapid demise of species on most planets. Now, it is our privilege to recreate life in our image.
$TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThis planet has already a primitive civilization.§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R无法在被殖民地的恒星系内进行。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RCannot be done in a system with a colony.§!

entries.zh: 以我们的形象创造一个原始文明。\n\n§H激活限制：§![from.gh_life_seeder_var]/3
entries.en: Creates a primitive civilization in our image. \n\n§HActivation limit:§! [from.gh_life_seeder_var] / 3

entries.zh: 这是[GetName]为利用熵能所创造的首批工作原型之一。
entries.en: One of the first working prototypes created during the efforts of [GetName] to harness entropy

entries.zh: 对大多数视觉系统而言，这颗晶体碎片看似暗淡无光，其微弱的白色光泽掩盖了其中蕴藏的巨大能量。虽然可能已被更先进的技术取代，但其构造与特性仍有许多值得学习之处。
entries.en: Deceptively dim to most visual systems, this crystal fragment's faint white shimmer belies the incredible amount of energy just barely contained within. Though it may be surpassed by newer techniques, its construction and properties still have much to teach.

entries.zh:
§H成为危机§!
§Y危机事件§!

[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName]已点燃其统治，开始掌控星系命运。那些不共享此愿景者将陷入烈焰征服之路，只留下灰烬。
entries.en:
§HBecome the Crisis§!
§YCrisis Event§!

[EVENT_TARGET_0.GetName] has ignited its dominion, starting to seize control of the galaxy's fate. Those who don't share this vision will be caught in a blazing trail of conquest, leaving only ashes behind.

entries.zh:
§H星系败北§!
§Y危机事件§!

最初的炽热抱负已成为点燃星系的火花。反对者已化为灰烬，彻底从历史抹去了。
entries.en:
§HGalaxy Defeated§!
§YCrisis Event§!

What started as a fiery ambition has become the spark that ignited the galaxy. Those who opposed us have been reduced to ashes, along with their history.
